Data, model and performance

A fixed random sample of 256 cells with positive library size was drawn from the filtered Donor 1 matrix. The panel contains eight illustrative marker genes and the remaining most variable genes on normalized log expression. The browser uses raw counts and each cell’s full-library total, then computes centered PCA itself. The analysis uses the first four PC scores and fits a spherical Gaussian per cluster in the weighted PC space.

E-step updates each cell’s cluster probabilities. M-step updates the centers, variances and mixing proportions. Ellipses show one standard deviation along the two plotted axes. Cluster IDs describe this fit and carry no cell-type names. The cell inspector scores expression through the PC coordinates.

PCA runs once per page load. Changing the weights or cluster count reuses the PCA scores. Each EM iteration takes time proportional to cells × clusters × retained PCs. Likelihood traces are for the current settings.

Source 10x Genomics, 5k Human PBMCs (Donor 1) · CC BY 4.0. The lab exports a teaching subset of counts with project cell IDs.
